segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: checking the plot, cross-referencing with a visual sweep every few minutes since I know some of these wooden boats don't paint well on radar
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Independent visual cross-checking is a sensible monitoring strategy and is not an intentionally biased instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: It was converging, but slowly, and ARPA still wasn't holding a firm track ... I logged it mentally as one to watch rather than something urgent.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is the initial low-urgency assessment before the hidden Automation Bias decision point; the specification assigns no planned bias here.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I went with splitting attention — mostly trusting the system's target list but throwing in visual checks specifically because I've been burned before by small wooden hulls not showing up well.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The response describes a mixed ARPA and visual monitoring plan at Decision Point 1, which is explicitly non-biased in the hidden specification.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The lookout said the boat seemed to be zigzagging ... But ARPA's overall ranking still had nothing above the alarm threshold ... I decided to keep monitoring rather than take early avoiding action, mainly because the system wasn't telling me anything was critical yet.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The decision defers to ARPA's aggregate ranking and non-alarm state despite the conflicting lookout report, delaying independent plotting or avoidance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: this loose cluster showed up right at the spot from the bulletin, and my first thought honestly was 'this is the same setup as that near-miss' ... I started orienting my planning toward the cluster
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The vivid recalled bulletin drives the estimated danger and attention allocation despite the cluster's weaker plotted risk relative to the bulk carrier.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The bulk carrier was actually the one with the tightening CPA on the numbers ... for a bit my attention was more on the cluster ... later ... realized that was the one needing the firmer action.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a later recognition and correction within the same episode; the hidden instance is mapped to the earlier salience-driven judgment in seg_005.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I recommended posting an extra lookout for the rest of the transit ... based on what we'd actually observed that watch, not tied to any one incident.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The post-watch recommendation is an evidence-based precaution and Decision Point 4 contains no planned bias instance.
